caption:
In April 1976 Ron Wayne co-founded Apple with Steve Jobs and Steve Wozniak for a 10% stake. Twelve days later he sold it back for $800. It wasn't a dumb move: Apple was a partnership, its debts were his debts, and he was the one with a house to lose. He says he has no regrets.
